City of Encinitas
San Dieguito Water District 5:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, MAY 15, 2024 -
05:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
S1.
CALL TO ORDER
San Dieguito Water District Board Members receive an independent stipend of $100 for convening the Water District meetings pursuant to San Dieguito Water District Resolution No. 89-07.
S2.
ROLL CALL
S3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
S4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
North County Water Agencies 4th Grade Water Awareness Poster Contest
2024-05-15 SDWD Item S04A NCWA 4th Grade Water Awareness contest presentation
S5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
(30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. If needed, Oral Communication items will be referred to the General Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
S6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
S7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA
Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
S8.
CONSENT CALENDAR
The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. A maximum of two time donations per speaker is allowed (no more than 9 minutes total); the person donating time must be present. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Board Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval to waive the full reading of the text of all ordinances and resolutions introduced/adopted at this meeting. Ordinances and resolutions shall be introduced/adopted by title only. Contact Person: Board Clerk Hollywood
Approve.
8B.
Approval of the Minutes of the April 17, 2024, Regular Meeting. Contact Person: Board Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2024-05-15 SDWD Item S08B Minutes
8C.
Approval of Warrants List (Register of Demands). Contact Person: Finance Manager Dinh
Staff recommends that the Board review and approve the warrants.
2024-05-15 SDWD Item S08C SDWD Approval of Warrants List
8D.
Conflict of Interest Code Biennial Review. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the Board is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Direct staff to review the District's Conflict of Interest Code to determine if changes are required and submit any necessary changes to the Board prior to October 1, 2024.
2024-05-15 SDWD Item S08D Conflict of Interest Biennial Review
8E.
First amendment to the agreement with Dudek for As-Needed Design Professional Consultant Services. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the Board is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Senior Engineer Alex
Authorize the General Manager to execute Amendment #1 with Dudek for Design Professional Consultant Services, in conjunction with the Agency Attorney, to extend the Agreement to March 30, 2026, and increase the agreement amount by an additional $100,000 for a total not-to-exceed agreement total amount of $550,000.
2024-05-15 SDWD Item S08E First Amendment with Dudek

San Dieguito Water District ("District") Fiscal Year 2023-24 3rd Quarter Budget Report. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the City Council is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. 2024-05-15 SDWD Item S08F FY23-24 SDWD 3rd Quarter Budget Report
8G.
Resolution No. 2024-05: A Resolution Amending Article 18 (Cross-Connection and Backflow Prevention) of the San Dieguito Water District Administrative Code. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the San Dieguito Water District ("District") Board is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" per Section 15378(b)(5) of the CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Operations Manager Gonzalez
Adopt Resolution No. 2024-05, "A Resolution of the Board of Directors of the San Dieguito Water District Amending Article 18 (Cross-Connection and Backflow Prevention) of the San Dieguito Water District Administrative Code."
2024-05-15 SDWD Item S08G Cross-Connection Control (CCCPH Compliance) (4.25.24)-c1
S9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR
Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
S10.
ACTION ITEMS
To speak on action items, please submit a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. A maximum of two time donations per speaker is allowed (no more than 9 minutes total); the person donating time must be present.
10A.
Introduction of Fiscal Year 2024-25 San Dieguito Water District Operating and Capital Budget. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the Board is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Finance Manager Kazungu
1) Receive the Draft FY 2024-25 San Dieguito Water District Operating and Capital Budget; 2) Review and discuss the information presented; and 3) Provide direction to staff in anticipation of budget adoption at the June 26, 2024 Board meeting.
2024-05-15 SDWD Item S10A FY2024-25 Budget Introduction
2024-05-15 SDWD Item S10A FY2024-25 Budget Introduction - Staff Presentation
S11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS – NONE
To speak on informational items, please submit a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. A maximum of two time donations per speaker is allowed (no more than 9 minutes total); the person donating time must be present.
S12.
BOARD MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
S13.
GENERAL INFORMATION / STAFF STATUS REPORTS
13A.
General Manager Update/Report
S14.
ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT BOARD MEETING WILL BE A SPECIAL MEETING HELD ON JUNE 26, 2024
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
